description: Opens closed days again for bookings. With unit_id it opens only what was closed for that unit (days closed for all units stay closed); without unit_id it opens every closed day in the range. Part of a longer closed range can be opened; the rest stays closed. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

to.description: Last night to open (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: same as from.

unit_id.description: Leave out to open the range for all units.

name: open_days
title: Open closed days again
